title: UCC Futures Scholars Programme (GoI) PhD scholarships - Research Ireland Empower Scheme
about: PhD scholarship call at University College Cork under the Research Ireland Empower scheme for doctoral students first registering between September 2026 and August 2027. Online interviews 9-12 February 2027; awards expected to start 1 October 2027.
requirements: First registered for the first year of doctoral study between 01 September 2026 and 31 August 2027

upskill.name: EduCut AI Academy course catalog
why: The call is open to all disciplines and states no subject requirement that a specific course objective covers, so the post links to the Academy catalog.
